an11.17:1.1: ekādasahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikattuṃ.
an11.17:1.3: idha bhikkhave gopālako na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti. na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti. ye te usabhā gopitaro goparināyakā te na atireka pūjāya pūjetā hoti.
an11.17:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave ekādasahi aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ, phātikattuṃ. evameva
an11.17:2.1: kho bhikkhave ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
an11.17:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti. na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti. anavasesadohī ca hoti. ye te bhikkhu therārattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā te na atireka pūjāya pūjetā hoti.
an11.17:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti:
an11.17:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cattāri mahābhūtāni catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an11.17:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhū na rūpaññū hoti.
an11.17:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti:
an11.17:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu, kamma lakkhaṇo bālo, kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍito’ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an11.17:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti.
an11.17:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti:
an11.17:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti. uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti. uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti, na anabhāvaṃ gameti.
an11.17:5.3: uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na byantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti.
an11.17:5.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti.
an11.17:6.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti:
an11.17:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī,
an11.17:6.3: ‘yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an11.17:6.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalādhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati, manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ nāpajjati.
an11.17:6.10: evaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti.
an11.17:7.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti:
an11.17:7.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ desetā hoti.
an11.17:7.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti.
an11.17:8.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na titthaṃ jānāti:
an11.17:8.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhu bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā, te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā na paripucchati, na paripañhati,
an11.17:8.4: tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañceva na vivaranti, anuttānīkatañca na uttānīkaronti. anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhānīyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ na paṭivinodenti.
an11.17:8.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na titthaṃ jānāti.
an11.17:9.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na pītaṃ jānāti:
an11.17:9.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne na labhati atthavedaṃ, na labhati dhammavedaṃ, na labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ.
an11.17:9.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na pītaṃ jānāti.
an11.17:10.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na vīthiṃ jānāti:
an11.17:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an11.17:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na vīthiṃ jānāti.
an11.17:11.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu na gocarakusalo hoti:
an11.17:11.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro satipaṭṭhāne yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an11.17:11.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na gocarakusalo hoti.
an11.17:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ saddhā gahapatikā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavārenti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena. tatra bhikkhu mattaṃ na jānāti paṭiggahaṇāya,
an11.17:12.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu anavasesadohī hoti.
an11.17:13.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhu therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā, te na atireka pūjāya pūjetā hoti.
an11.17:13.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhu therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā, tesu na mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpeti āvī ceva raho ca na mettaṃ vacīkammaṃ …pe… na mettaṃ mano kammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpeti āvī ceva raho ca.
an11.17:13.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhu therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā, te na atireka pūjāya pūjetā hoti.
an11.17:14.1: imehi kho bhikkhave ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
an11.17:15.1: ekādasahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako bhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ, phātikattuṃ,
an11.17:15.3: idha bhikkhave gopālako rūpaññū hoti. lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, titthaṃ jānāti, pītaṃ jānāti, vīthiṃ jānāti, gocarakusalo hoti, sāvasesadohī hoti, ye te usabhā gopitaro goparināyakā, te atireka pūjāya pūjetā hoti.
an11.17:15.4: imehi kho bhikkhave ekādasahi aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako bhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ, phātikattuṃ. evameva
an11.17:16.1: kho bhikkhave ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo imasmiṃ dhamma vinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ
an11.17:16.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu rūpaññū hoti lakkhaṇa kusalo hoti, āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, titthaṃ jānāti, pītaṃ jānāti, gocarakusalo hoti, sāvasesadohī hoti, ye te bhikkhu therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā, te atireka pūjāya pūjetā hoti.
an11.17:17.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ cattāri mahābhūtāni, catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpantī yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
an11.17:17.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhū rūpaññū hoti.
an11.17:18.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ‘kammalakkhaṇo bālo, kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍito’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
an11.17:18.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu lakkhaṇakusalo hoti.

an11.17:19.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti.

an11.17:20.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti, nānubyañjanaggāhī
an11.17:20.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya āpajjati.
an11.17:20.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti.

an11.17:21.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ desetā hoti.
an11.17:21.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhūmaṃ kattā hoti.

an11.17:26.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sāvasesadohī hoti.

an11.17:27.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhu therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā te atireka pūjāya pūjetā hoti.
